title: More treated water for Selangor | The Star
text: More treated water for Selangor | The Star × View Community More treated water for Selangor By QISHIN TARIQ Friday, 20 May 2016 | 12:00 AM MYT share bookmark Related Stories Singapore 26 Sep 2026 Air quality in Singapore's central region back in unhealthy range; 24-hour PSI reading at 108 Singapore 1d ago Haze in Singapore: Air quality in all five regions unhealthy, PM2.5 readings elevated across island Singapore 19 Sep 2026 Haze in Singapore: PSI in central region back in the unhealthy range Flood mitigation works in the Kajang town area will be undertaken near the Jalan Bukit bridge. — AZHAR MAHFOF/ The Star SELANGOR’S water supply is set to be secured as two new treatment plants are due to be completed by 2018. State Infrastructure and Public Facilities Committee chairman Zaidy Abdul Talib said once completed, the two plants – Semenyih 2 and Labohan Dagang – would respectively produce 100 million and 400 million litres of water a day, enough for 50,000 users.
